column1: BUG-03: Invalid email format accepted on create and update
column29:
Module: Create and Update Employee

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Send POST /api/employees with "email": "invalid-email-1792856870" (no @ and no domain).
# Send PATCH /api/employees/{id} with the body {"email": "not-an-email"}.

Expected Result
400 Bad Request with an email-format error.

Actual Result
Create returns 201 Created and stores the invalid email (id 9). Update returns 200 OK and record id 6 now has the email "not-an-email".

Impact
Unusable contact data is stored. Email is used for identity, filtering and duplicate checks.

*Test cases:* TC15, TC95

column1: BUG-04: Duplicate email accepted when letter case differs
column29:
Module: Create Employee (POST /api/employees)

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Take an existing employee's email, for example [cheyenne.gaylord.179285686912771@company.com|mailto:cheyenne.gaylord.179285686912771@company.com] (id 8).
# Send POST /api/employees with the same address in upper case ([CHEYENNE.GAYLORD.179285686912771@COMPANY.COM|mailto:CHEYENNE.GAYLORD.179285686912771@COMPANY.COM]) and a different phone number.

Expected Result
409 Conflict (or 400 Bad Request). Email addresses are case-insensitive in practice.

Actual Result
201 Created. A second record (id 24) is stored with the upper-case email. An exact duplicate is rejected correctly (TC16).

Impact
Two employee records exist for one email address.

*Test case:* TC75

column1: BUG-05: Invalid status handled inconsistently on create and update
column29:
Module: Create and Update Employee

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Send POST /api/employees with "status": "xyz".
# Send PATCH /api/employees/{id} with the body {"status": "banana"}.

Expected Result
400 Bad Request that lists the allowed status values.

Actual Result
Create returns 201 Created and silently changes the value to "active" (id 13). Update returns 200 OK and stores the arbitrary value "banana" (id 6).

Impact
The client is not told its input was rejected. Arbitrary statuses break status filters and business rules.

*Test cases:* TC45, TC96

column1: BUG-10: limit query parameter is not validated
column29:
Module: Get All Employees (GET /api/employees)

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Send GET /api/employees?limit=-1.
# Repeat with limit=0 and with limit=abc.

Expected Result
400 Bad Request, because limit must be a whole number of 1 or more.

Actual Result
200 OK in all cases. limit=-1 returns an employee list. limit=0 and limit=abc return an empty data array with "totalPages": null and "limit" set to 0 or null.

Impact
Paging information is inconsistent and clients fail silently.

*Test cases:* TC49, TC80, TC81

column1: BUG-07: Invalid hireDate format accepted on create
column29:
Module: Create Employee (POST /api/employees)

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Send POST /api/employees with "hireDate": "15-31-2024" (an impossible date).

Expected Result
400 Bad Request for an invalid date.

Actual Result
201 Created. Record id 15 stores "hireDate": "15-31-2024".

column1: BUG-09: Invalid or expired token returns 403 instead of 401
column29:
Module: Authentication (all protected endpoints)

Steps to Reproduce

# Send POST, GET, PATCH or DELETE to any /api/employees endpoint.
# Set the header Authorization: Bearer invalid.token.value.

Expected Result
401 Unauthorized, because authentication failed.

Actual Result
403 Forbidden with the message "Invalid or expired token". A missing token correctly returns 401, so the behaviour is inconsistent.

Impact
Clients that treat 401 as "log in again" will not refresh an expired session.

*Test cases:* TC73, TC91, TC104, TC108

column1: BUG-01: Negative, non-numeric and out-of-range salary accepted on create
column29:
Module: Create Employee (POST /api/employees)

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin (POST /api/auth/login) and copy the token.
# Send POST /api/employees with a valid body but "salary": -5000.
# Repeat with "salary": "abc", "salary": "50000" (a string) and "salary": 9999999999999.

Expected Result
400 Bad Request with a validation message. Salary must be a positive number within a sensible range.

Actual Result
201 Created for every value. Stored records show -5000 (id 10), "abc" (id 11), 9999999999999 (id 18) and "50000" stored as a string (id 19).

Impact
Payroll data is corrupted and salary calculations will fail or give wrong results.

*Test cases:* TC17, TC42, TC66, TC67

column1: BUG-02: Negative and non-numeric salary accepted on update
column29:
Module: Update Employee (PATCH /api/employees/:id)

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Send PATCH /api/employees/{id} with the body {"salary": -100}.
# Repeat with the body {"salary": "lots"}.

Expected Result
400 Bad Request, using the same salary rules as create.

Actual Result
200 OK with the message "Employee updated successfully". Record id 6 now holds salary -100, and later "lots".

Impact
Validation on create can be bypassed by updating the record afterwards.

*Test cases:* TC46, TC98

column1: BUG-06: First name accepts blank, numeric and 300-character values
column29:
Module: Create Employee (POST /api/employees)

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Send POST /api/employees with "firstName": " " (a single space).
# Repeat with "firstName": "J0hn123" and with a 300-character string of the letter A.

Expected Result
400 Bad Request. A first name should not be blank, should contain letters only, and should have a maximum length.

Actual Result
201 Created for all three values. They are stored as sent (ids 21, 22 and 12). A completely empty first name is rejected correctly (TC43).

Impact
Poor data quality. Very long names can break screen layouts and reports.
*Test cases:* TC44, TC69, TC70

column1: BUG-11: page query parameter is not validated
column29:
Module: Get All Employees (GET /api/employees)

Steps to Reproduce

# Log in as admin and copy the token.
# Send GET /api/employees?page=0.
# Repeat with page=-5.

Expected Result
400 Bad Request, because page must be 1 or more.

Actual Result
200 OK with an empty data array. The response shows "currentPage": 0 or -5.

Impact
Invalid paging input is accepted and gives misleading empty results.

*Test cases:* TC82, TC83
